nginx 502 'upstream prematurely closed connection' on localhost:2026; frontend next dev --turbo hung at 'Compiling /workspace/chats/[thread_id]' forever (CPU ~4%, never reached 'Compiled'); all routes timed out
bugs.root_cause: Docker Desktop Linux engine crashed/restarted (unclean shutdown), corrupting the 4.4GB .next/dev Turbopack cache. The cache lives in the container writable layer, so a plain `docker restart`/`docker compose restart` did NOT clear it -> every restart re-hung on the same corrupted compile.
bugs.fix: Force-recreate the frontend container for a fresh writable layer (no stale .next): `cd docker && docker compose -p eai-docker -f docker-compose-dev.yaml -f docker-compose.extensions.yaml -f docker-compose.temporal.yaml -f docker-compose.ragflow.yaml up -d --force-recreate frontend`. Cold compiles then complete (CPU >200%) and routes return 200.

contract-price cpa_ ORM model drift: skill mirror models.py diverged from canonical extension models.py / physical tables
bugs.root_cause: Extension is the canonical writer (Gateway Base, creates physical tables) and evolved (doc_hash widened 128->256; added cpa_items.edit_note TEXT), but the skill's mirror models.py was not kept in sync. The two describe the same physical cpa_* tables, so drift silently risks corrupting reads/writes across the agent-CLI and extension paths.
bugs.fix: Aligned skill mirror to physical ground truth (queried information_schema): doc_hash String(256), added edit_note TEXT to CpaItem. Added backend/tests/test_contract_price_model_parity.py that loads the skill model by path and asserts all 4 cpa_ tables match column-for-column (skips in CI where the gitignored skill is absent).

bugs.error_message: Pipeline run never persisted data; management page always empty
bugs.root_cause: _persist wrote CpaItem(document_id=uuid.uuid4()) random uuid, violating the cpa_items.document_id FK -> IntegrityError rolled back the WHOLE commit (docs+clusters+run_history), masked by a broad except labeled "DB unavailable". Item->document link was also never threaded through parse/cluster.
bugs.fix: Thread source_doc_id through ParsedItem->all_items->_build_groups; _persist upserts CpaDocument by ragflow_doc_id, deletes stale items on re-parse, and links each item to its real document row. Verified: run_history now persists (completed row).

bugs.error_message: Adding scikit-learn to gateway deps blocked gateway startup (502)
bugs.root_cause: scikit-learn pulls scipy (~33MB wheel); uv sync default UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=30s timed out downloading it on a flaky link, and the gateway entrypoint keeps uvicorn down when sync fails.
bugs.fix: Dropped sklearn/scipy entirely; reimplemented char-wb TF-IDF + DBSCAN as numpy-only (numpy already a transitive dep). Pipeline now runs in the gateway container without heavy downloads.

bugs.error_message: contract-price pipeline never ran end-to-end in Docker: skill CLI subprocess died on import (ModuleNotFoundError) and UI 'Run pipeline' silently failed
bugs.root_cause: service.run_pipeline_subprocess spawned the CLI with bare 'python'. The gateway PID-1 env PATH has NO .venv/bin (uv runs uvicorn via the venv binary's shebang, not via PATH), so bare 'python' resolved to the container SYSTEM python (/usr/local/bin/python) which has zero pipeline deps (no sqlalchemy/asyncpg/httpx/numpy/xlsxwriter). Initial misdiagnosis blamed a missing sklearn, but sklearn is deliberately excluded — clustering is numpy-only (engine.py/vectorizer.py reimplement DBSCAN+TF-IDF to avoid scipy) and the venv already has every dep the pipeline needs.
bugs.fix: Changed subprocess cmd from "python" to sys.executable so the CLI runs under the same venv interpreter the gateway app runs under (the project venv, which has all deps). uvicorn --reload picked it up. Verified: `python -m scripts.cli --help` runs clean under /app/backend/.venv/bin/python. NO package install was needed.

bugs.error_message: contract-price pipeline failed: HTTPStatusError 404 from RAGFlow (http://eai-flow-ragflow:9380/datasets/.../documents) — every RAGFlow call 404'd, runs flaked (some completed-with-0-docs, some failed)
bugs.root_cause: RAGFLOW_BASE_URL was set to http://eai-flow-ragflow:9380 WITHOUT the /api/v1 version prefix (same omission in all 5 definitions: .env.docker, docker-compose-dev.yaml, .env, backend/.env, docker-compose-offline.yaml). ragflow_client used it as the httpx base_url, so calls hit /datasets/... instead of /api/v1/datasets/... → 404. The 404 body was non-JSON so error handling was inconsistent (sometimes caught → completed 0 docs, sometimes httpx HTTPStatusError escaped → failed).
bugs.fix: Made ragflow_client.RagflowClient.__init__ normalize base_url: append /api/v1 when the URL lacks any /api/vN segment. Durable code fix, takes effect on next run with no gateway restart, and tolerates any misconfigured env. Also corrected .env.docker:18 to include /api/v1. Verified: list_documents returns doc_count=0 cleanly (no 404); UI run at 00:58 completed. KB a8e8f3dc... is empty (0 docs) — that's a data state, not a bug.
